## Legal Basis for Processing  
**Lawful Bases Used by FirstUK Bank:**  
| Purpose | Lawful Basis | Data Retained |
|---------|-------------|----------------|
| Account opening & management | Contractual necessity | Account tenure + 6 years |
| KYC/AML compliance | Legal obligation | 5-6 years post-closure |
| Fraud detection | Legitimate interest | 3 years |
| Marketing (if consented) | Explicit consent | Until withdrawal |
| Regulatory reporting | Legal obligation | Per regulation (5-7 years) |
| Complaint handling | Contractual & legal | 8 weeks (FCA requirement) |

raw_entities.name: Data Processing and Retention Policy
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's policy governing lawful bases for personal data processing across account management, KYC/AML compliance, fraud detection, marketing, regulatory reporting, and complaint handling. The policy establishes retention periods aligned with contractual necessity, legal obligation, and legitimate interest grounds.
context: Lawful Bases Used by FirstUK Bank
Account opening & management | Contractual necessity | Account tenure + 6 years
KYC/AML compliance | Legal obligation | 5-6 years post-closure
Fraud detection | Legitimate interest | 3 years

raw_entities.name: Account Opening and Management Data Retention
raw_entities.description: Requires retention of account opening and management data for the duration of account tenure plus 6 years thereafter, justified on the basis of contractual necessity.
context: Account opening & management | Contractual necessity | Account tenure + 6 years

raw_entities.name: KYC/AML Compliance Data Retention
raw_entities.description: Mandates retention of KYC/AML compliance data for 5-6 years following account closure, grounded in legal obligation to maintain audit trails and compliance evidence.
context: KYC/AML compliance | Legal obligation | 5-6 years post-closure

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Data Retention
raw_entities.description: Specifies retention of fraud detection data for 3 years, justified on the basis of legitimate interest in protecting the bank and its customers from financial crime.
context: Fraud detection | Legitimate interest | 3 years

raw_entities.name: Marketing Consent Data Retention
raw_entities.description: Requires retention of marketing data only where explicit customer consent has been obtained, with retention continuing until the customer withdraws consent.
context: Marketing (if consented) | Explicit consent | Until withdrawal

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Reporting Data Retention
raw_entities.description: Mandates retention of regulatory reporting data in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, typically 5-7 years, to satisfy legal obligation obligations.
context: Regulatory reporting | Legal obligation | Per regulation (5-7 years)

raw_entities.name: Complaint Handling Data Retention
raw_entities.description: Requires retention of complaint handling data for 8 weeks as mandated by FCA requirements, grounded in both contractual and legal obligations.
context: Complaint handling | Contractual & legal | 8 weeks (FCA requirement)
